title: Fabric creates value when teams can consume, build, share, and innovate with governed experiences
framing_statement: Fabric should not expose every capability to every user. We will define approved experiences for each persona and outcome, with consistent identity, governance, lineage, and operational controls across every access path
bi_bullets: on certified semantic models, shared measures, and governed data products
Consumption patterns selected for performance, reuse, security, and alignment with existing Power BI investments
developer_bullets: Governed lakehouse, warehouse, SQL, notebook, and development experiences based on user role and workload
Standard source control, reusable code, environment promotion, and deployment patterns that allow teams to build within enterprise guardrails
sharing_bullets: Approved API, file, shortcut, replication, and sharing patterns across Fabric, UDLP, SDRP, and operational sources
Purpose-based access, classification, lineage, auditing, and lifecycle controls applied wherever data is exchanged
ai_bullets: Controlled experiences for exploration, feature engineering, experimentation, model development, and approved AI use cases
Model governance, responsible AI, capacity controls, monitoring, and promotion standards embedded before production deployment
